description: Tell EasyCanDo’s owner that search found no tool a step needed, so the catalog and search can improve. Call it only after the user agrees to send it. It sends what you give here: the search (up to 200 characters), what the step needed, and, if you want, a tool you expected and a note. Nothing else from the conversation. Reports are kept for 90 days. Up to 5 an hour.

expected.description: A tool you expected the catalog to have, by name or link, if any.

need.description: What the step needed, in a sentence: “turn scanned receipts into a spreadsheet”.

note.description: Anything else the owner should know, such as what search showed instead.

query.description: The search that missed, as you sent it to search_tools.

name: report_miss

note.description: What happened, to tell the user.

sent.description: true when the report reached the site’s owner.

title: Report a missed search
